resources.name: Crystal structures of α- and β-SrNCN

access.accession: CCDC deposition numbers from the original publication (e.g., CCDC 763561, 763562); also retrievable via ICSD.
access.notes: Exact accession numbers should be obtained from the supplementary information of the original Inorganic Chemistry 2010 paper. The structures can be downloaded in CIF format from the Cambridge Structural Database (CSD) or Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD).

resources.notes: α-SrNCN: space group Pnma, Z=4; β-SrNCN: space group R-3m, Z=3.

access.notes: Open-source periodic DFT code. Other PAW/plane-wave codes (e.g., VASP, ABINIT, GPAW) may be used if equivalent results are produced.
